notes.title: Game Guide and Bonus Codes
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you for playing Incremental Epic Breakers (IEB) and for all your comments.
As I mentioned in my IEH post, Kei and Hitan are working on IEH, while Suguru and Koga are working on IEB.

The IEB team in particular is still new to Idle game development, so your comments and opinions are very helpful to us. We will take your comments and suggestions seriously and incorporate them into the game one by one so that we can continue to improve the gameplay of IEB. Thank you so much for all your support!


[h2]Game Guide[/h2]
Now, as many of you have commented, there is a lot of content already implemented in IEB, but most of it is in a very confusing game system. In the last update (ver. 1.2.1.1), we added game hints in various places, but I think there are still many parts that are difficult to understand. This time, I'd like to write a brief game guide to give you a hint on how to play the game, especially in the early stages.

- Always try to use the circular [b]"Nitro Booster"[/b] in the upper left corner of the screen.
[b]"Nitro Booster"[/b] greatly accelerates the progress of the game while consuming the nitro you have stored. Nitro is especially easy to accumulate when you are offline, so don't be afraid to use it.

- In the "Routine" tab, try to use automation features such as [b]"Boost"[/b] and [b]"Horizontal Unlock"[/b]. This will allow you to play the game without leaving it. As you progress through the game, some things will automatically regenerate the map or auto-purchase Improvements.

- Try to place a lot of Craft [b]"Arrow"[/b] on the map. This will further automate the map progression.

- During a Challenge, placing a Craft on a map [b]one tier lower[/b] will greatly increase the stats of your base. "Tier" in this game means "10 to the [Tier] power" scaling, starting with a Tier 0 map (10^0 meters) and zooming out to a Tier 1 map (10^1 meters) as you clear that map. During the slime challenge, you will fight slimes on the tier 1 (10^1 meter) map. At this time, the base in the upper left corner of the map is enhanced by crafting on the Tier 0 (10^0 meter) map.


[h2]Guide Movie[/h2]
We have posted a video of the gameplay up to "Slime Challenge" so that you can get a better understanding of this game. 
I hope this helps new players!
[previewyoutube=T-o1H_m-Pvw;full][/previewyoutube]

The above is a brief, but helpful hint of things that may improve your early game play.
We will try to display this information in the game in the near future.


[h2]Bonus Code[/h2]
Finally, bonus codes that can be used within IEB are listed here.
[b]- IEBhapiwaku
- IEBreincarnation
- IEBsteam[/b]


Once again, thank you all so much for your supportive comments!
We, the IEB development team, will continue to work on improving this game, so please keep up the good work!
